steps.what: Organize raw footage and interpret scripts or director instructions
String footage into an initial continuous sequence according to the assembly brief

loop.purpose: Propose a script-matched rough assembly in a duplicate timeline
loop.input: Organised clips, audio, verified clip/timebase metadata and assembly brief
loop.output: Rough timeline with clip references, transcript matches and alternatives
loop.check: Editor watches every selected segment against source and brief, checks speaker meaning, take identity, continuity and omitted directions
loop.stop: One rough assembly and one correction; unclear dialogue or instructions return to manual assembly
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact clip lists use native deterministic assembly; matching unscripted or varied spoken takes to intended content needs contextual matching

steps.what: Refine continuity and approve the complete internal footage assembly

tasks.design: Try native script-matched rough assembly in the editing application in {OTHER}, with the script in {DOCS}. The editor verifies selected source material and shapes continuity before approving an internal assembly for director review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated clip placement and spoken-take matching could consume assembly time.
tasks.enabler_now: Editing applications can propose script-linked rough timelines while retaining source clips and alternate takes.
tasks.still_hard: A script match does not establish the best performance, pacing or visual continuity.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the director's intent and protect the meaning and rhythm of the scene.
tasks.altitude: Rough assembly may shorten; editorial judgement and director sign-off remain unchanged.

reach.task: Capture clearly identified takes and usable continuity

evidence.claim: DaVinci Resolve 20 IntelliScript matches clip transcripts to scripts and builds a rough cut with alternate takes; it does not deliver a finished edit.
The local assembly saving is an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means a video editing application. Boundary is media organisation, rough assembly and continuity refinement, not separate full-footage familiarisation4060 or artistic shot selection4053. Shared timeline actions are allocated once in role roll-ups.

Production supplies footage and script before s1. Editor produces clip IDs, file versions, frame rates/timebases, audio associations, script version, scene order and director constraints in s1's retained25 hours, including missing-metadata capture. Any machine transcript is generated from those clips during s2 and verified within its retained27 hours, not assumed free pre-existing text. Missing or unreliable alignment uses manual assembly.
Native assembly and import functions precede custom code; existing rendering/runtime creates no labour saving.

Six focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover media/version checks and rough-cut exceptions; two other-role support hours cover workstation configuration. Existing director review stays outside and unchanged.

steps.what: Edit sequences, insert music, dialogue and sound effects, and correct errors using editing equipment

tasks.design: Retain creative picture and sound refinement in the editing application in {OTHER}. Existing timeline, mixing and correction controls support the editor without assuming that their runtime is new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sound placement and error correction depend on scene meaning and timing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing editing controls already support this work.
tasks.still_hard: A technically clean insertion can damage performance, intelligibility or dramatic rhythm.
tasks.human_edge: Judge how picture and sound work together over the complete sequence.
tasks.altitude: Creative editing time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check sound and picture technical integrity

evidence.claim: Premiere Pro text-based editing enables transcript-driven cuts; this does not establish savings across creative music, effects and sequence refinement.

assumptions: OTHER means a video editing application. Boundary is creative audiovisual refinement; mechanical rough assembly4057 and artistic shot selection4053 are assigned separately without duplicate timeline labour.

tasks.short: Select shots and shape a coherent story

steps.what: Select and combine effective shots to form a logical and smoothly running story

tasks.design: Retain performance selection and story shaping with the editor in {OTHER}. A rough assembly provides material to judge rather than a decision about the most effective shot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Story effect depends on performance, juxtaposition and pacing beyond dialogue matching.
tasks.enabler_now: Rough-cut aids exist, but no new capability is assumed to choose the finished story.
tasks.still_hard: Several technically valid edits can have very different emotional meanings.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise the take and cut that best serve the intended story.
tasks.altitude: Creative decision rights and story-shaping time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Plan coverage that preserves editorial options

evidence.claim: DaVinci Resolve IntelliScript produces a rough cut with alternate takes; the digest explicitly distinguishes this from a finished edit.

assumptions: OTHER means a video editing application. Boundary is artistic selection and combination, excluding mechanical rough assembly counted under4057 and full familiarisation4060. Overlapping cut operations have one owner in the role roll-up.

Editor produces take choices, source ranges, sequence positions and pacing decisions during retained100 hours after source footage and story intent are available. No pre-produced best-shot or story-quality flag is assumed; uncertainty is resolved by viewing alternatives.
Native timeline functions precede custom development; no new model is introduced for creative selection.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process and tools are unchanged.
unknowns: Balance of performance selection and mechanical assembly

tasks.short: Review footage to become familiar with it

steps.what: Review footage sequence by sequence to become familiar with performances and coverage

tasks.design: Retain sequence viewing in the editing application in {OTHER}. Searchable text can help find a known line but does not replace becoming familiar with visual performance and coverage.
tasks.previous_blocker: The editor needs direct knowledge of what was actually captured.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle reactions and usable silent moments may not appear in transcripts.
tasks.human_edge: Notice performance details and unexpected visual possibilities.
tasks.altitude: Viewing responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Understand how captured coverage is used
